name: showcase-4-variant-comparison
title: Five-variant perturbation sweep — which perturbation most clearly moves v2ecoli off baseline
question:
Of the four perturbations proposed in showcase-3 (ppGpp regulation OFF, a
dnaA 2x expression knob, a slower ribosome elongation rate, and a media /
condition change to succinate), which one most clearly and interpretably
moves the v2ecoli whole cell off its wild-type baseline? Run all four as a
single multivariant sweep against the showcase-2 baseline and quantify each
variant's delta across growth, replication, regulation, central-carbon flux,
and proteome.

report.title: showcase-4 — five-variant perturbation sweep vs the wild-type baseline
report.evidence_quality: 5-variant x 2-seed multigen sweep + 8 cross-variant comparison figures
report.objective:
Resolve the showcase-3 reviewer decision empirically by running ALL four
candidate perturbations (rather than picking one) as a single 5-variant
sweep (baseline + 4), and measure how far each variant moves the cell off
the wild-type baseline across five readout classes: growth (doubling time,
cell mass), replication (oriC copy number / re-initiation timing),
regulation (ppGpp pool, tRNA charging), central-carbon metabolism (FBA flux
+ Toya-2010 correlation), and the proteome (Schmidt / Wisniewski
correlation). The deliverable is a ranked, quantitative contrast that seeds
the next-direction decision (showcase-5).
report.setup:
Sweep: 5 variants x 2 seeds, resumed from the showcase-1 full ParCa caches.
Variant 0 baseline / 1 ppgpp-off / 2 dnaA-2x / 3 elong-down all run on the
glucose cache (out/cache-showcase, 51-condition full ParCa); variant 4
media-succinate runs on its OWN succinate cache (out/cache-succinate,
condition=succinate / fixed_media=minimal_succinate). Generations vary by
phenotype and are themselves a contrast: baseline / dnaA-2x / elong-down /
media reach 3 generations, ppgpp-off only 2 (it grows slower). max_steps
6500/cell; total sweep wall ~2982 s on the mac mini.
Variant levers (config_overrides on the runner):
  - ppgpp-off  = ecoli-transcript-initiation.ppgpp_regulation=False +
                 ecoli-polypeptide-elongation.ppgpp_regulation=False,
                 DEFAULT_FEATURES dropped.
  - dnaA-2x    = ecoli-transcript-initiation.perturbations
                 {TU00259[c]: 2.117e-5} (2x the basal 1.058e-5 init prob).
  - elong-down = ecoli-polypeptide-elongation.basal_elongation_rate 22->15.4.
  - media      = succinate cache (condition=succinate,
                 fixed_media=minimal_succinate); no config_override.
The 8 cross-variant comparison analyses (v2ecoli/workflow/analyses/
{growth_overlay, doubling_time_grouped, mass_fraction_grouped,
replication_overlay, proteome_delta, fba_flux_overlay, regulation_overlay,
scorecard}) consumed the sweep's hive-partitioned parquet directly; sim_data
was hydrated from the showcase ParCa fixture
(out/sim_data-showcase/parca_state.pkl.gz via hydrate_sim_data_from_state)
and Schmidt/Wisniewski + Toya-2010 validation data attached. Figures
rendered to PNG+SVG via scripts/render_variant_comparison.py with the real
variant_metadata {0:baseline, 1:ppgpp-off, 2:dnaA-2x, 3:elong-down,
4:media-succinate}.
report.result:
Measured per-variant scorecard (delta vs baseline; from the scorecard /
doubling_time_grouped / regulation_overlay / replication_overlay /
fba_flux_overlay / proteome_delta figures):

  metric            baseline  ppgpp-off  dnaA-2x  elong-down  media-succinate
  doubling (min)      51.1      61.6      48.4      49.3        52.9
  dry mass (fg)        492       510       489       487         271   <- -45%
  protein fraction    0.461     0.430     0.453     0.435       0.532  <- +0.07
  max oriC               4         4         4         4           2   <- never multiforks
  mean ppGpp          64.8     120.6      67.9      61.2        56.4   <- 1.86x (ppgpp-off)
  Schmidt r          0.734     0.696     0.737     0.741       0.716
  Toya r             0.727     0.764     0.457     0.698      -0.058   <- collapses (succinate)

Strongest, most interpretable contrast = media-succinate: dry mass nearly
halved (271 vs 492 fg), the cell never multiforks (max oriC stays 2 vs 4),
protein fraction rises to 0.532, and the central-carbon FBA flux distribution
decorrelates from the glucose-grown Toya-2010 measurements (Toya r collapses
from 0.73 to -0.06, with the largest flux shifts on the TCA / succinate-entry
reactions: SUCCINATE-DEHYDROGENASE, 2OXOGLUTARATEDEH, MALATE-DEH).
Second strongest = ppgpp-off: the ppGpp pool RISES to ~230 by end-of-run
(mean 120.6, 1.86x baseline) rather than collapsing, and growth slows the
most (doubling 61.6 min, +10.5; only 2 generations reached). This is the
honest, slightly counter-intuitive result — disabling ppGpp *regulation*
(the feedback the ribosome/RNAP allocation reads) does NOT stop ppGpp
*synthesis*, so without the feedback ppGpp accumulates and growth falls.
dnaA-2x is a PARTIAL contrast: it does NOT raise the max oriC count above
baseline (both peak at 4), but it advances the timing of replication
re-initiation (the dnaA-2x oriC curve rises to 4 earlier and re-initiates
earlier in the second cycle) and it noticeably degrades the central-carbon
flux match (Toya r 0.727 -> 0.457). elong-down is the WEAKEST contrast: the
22->15.4 basal-elongation-rate cut barely moves the cap-immune doubling time
(49.3 vs 51.1 min, actually marginally faster), and its proteome / mass /
replication readouts are essentially baseline — the steady-state charging
model and variable-elongation machinery appear to compensate. tRNA charged
fraction stays ~0.97 across ALL variants. The proteome is the least
discriminating axis overall: every variant stays tightly correlated to the
baseline proteome (Schmidt r 0.70-0.74, Wisniewski ~0.61 across the board).
report.interpretation:
Running all four candidates rather than choosing one was the right call: it
converted the showcase-3 reviewer decision into a measured ranking. The
media / condition change is the most demonstrative single perturbation —
it moves the cell off baseline on FOUR independent axes at once (mass,
replication, composition, central-carbon flux) and the Toya-r collapse is a
clean, physiologically-grounded signature of a different carbon source. The
ppGpp-off result is the most scientifically informative surprise: the
regulatory knock-out does not silence ppGpp, it de-represses it, so the
"ppGpp collapse" intuition is wrong for this lever — worth flagging to
reviewers. dnaA-2x demonstrates the targeted gene-knob path works (it shifts
replication timing + central-carbon flux) but does not push the discrete
oriC ceiling, so its contrast is real but subtle. elong-down is a near-null
at this magnitude — a useful negative control, but not a compelling showcase
perturbation on its own.
report.decision:
PASS — the 5-variant sweep ran to completion and the 8 cross-variant
comparison figures resolve the showcase-3 decision with measured deltas.
Three of the four perturbations produce a clear, interpretable contrast vs
baseline (media-succinate strongest, ppgpp-off second, dnaA-2x partial); the
fourth (elong-down) is a near-null at this magnitude. The gate passes,
unblocking showcase-5 (the next-direction decision), which is seeded below
to deepen the strongest contrast (media / growth-condition response) and to
chase the ppGpp-off surprise.

variants.name: ppgpp-off
variants.expected_contrast: ppGpp regulatory feedback removed -> growth-rate / allocation response
variants.measured_contrast: PARTIAL-as-expected: growth slows MOST (doubling 61.6 min, +10.5; only 2 gens reached) but the ppGpp pool RISES (mean 120.6, 1.86x baseline; trace climbs to ~230) rather than collapsing — disabling regulation de-represses synthesis.

variants.name: dnaA-2x
variants.expected_contrast: more DnaA -> earlier / more replication initiation (raised oriC)
variants.measured_contrast: PARTIAL: does NOT raise max oriC (both peak at 4) but ADVANCES re-initiation timing (oriC->4 earlier; earlier 2nd-cycle re-init) and degrades central-carbon flux match (Toya r 0.727 -> 0.457).

variants.name: elong-down
variants.measured_contrast: WEAK / near-null: cap-immune doubling time barely moves (49.3 vs 51.1 min, marginally FASTER not slower); mass / proteome / replication ~baseline. tRNA charging + variable-elongation appear to compensate at this magnitude.

variants.name: media-succinate
variants.perturbation: growth condition glucose -> succinate (own full ParCa cache)
variants.expected_contrast: different carbon source -> shifted central-carbon flux + slower growth
variants.measured_contrast: STRONGEST: dry mass nearly halved (271 vs 492 fg), never multiforks (max oriC 2 vs 4), protein fraction up to 0.532, and Toya-2010 central-carbon flux correlation collapses 0.727 -> -0.058 (largest shifts on TCA / succinate-entry reactions).

assumptions.text:
The showcase-2 wild-type baseline (variant 0) is validated, so each
variant's delta is a clean contrast against a trusted reference.

The four perturbations are the four candidates proposed in showcase-3
(ppGpp-off, dnaA knob, elongation-rate sweep point, media change); running
all four resolves the showcase-3 reviewer decision empirically.

tests.name: ppgpp-off-perturbs-ppgpp-and-growth
tests.question: Does disabling ppGpp regulation measurably perturb the ppGpp pool and slow growth vs baseline?

measure.detail: Ratio of the ppgpp-off mean ppGpp pool to baseline; pass if it moves substantially off 1.0 (direction-agnostic). Cross-checked against doubling time (expect slower).

tests.name: dnaa-2x-shifts-replication-and-flux
tests.question: Does the dnaA-2x knob shift replication initiation and/or the central-carbon flux match vs baseline?

measure.detail: Drop in the Toya-2010 central-carbon flux correlation under dnaA-2x (proxy for the metabolic shift), plus a qualitative check that oriC re-initiation timing advances. NOTE: max oriC does NOT increase (both peak at 4) so the naive 'raises oriC count' expectation FAILS; the contrast is in timing + flux.

tests.name: elong-down-lengthens-doubling-time
tests.question: Does the 22->15.4 aa/s ribosome elongation-rate cut lengthen the doubling time vs baseline?

measure.detail: Increase in cap-immune doubling time under elong-down. Expected positive (slower); FAILS because the measured value is marginally NEGATIVE (49.3 - 51.1 = -1.8 min).

tests.name: media-shifts-central-carbon-flux
tests.question: Does the succinate media change shift the central-carbon flux distribution (decorrelate from glucose-grown Toya-2010) and slow growth?

measure.detail: Drop in the Toya-2010 central-carbon flux correlation under succinate (0.727 -> -0.058 = 0.785 drop). Cross-checked against dry mass (halved) and max oriC (2 vs 4).

resolved_uncertainties: showcase-3's open reviewer decision is resolved empirically: all four candidate perturbations were run as a 5-variant sweep, and the media / condition change is the most demonstrative single perturbation (moves the cell off baseline on mass, replication, composition, and central-carbon flux simultaneously).

ppGpp-off does NOT collapse the ppGpp pool — it de-represses it (mean ppGpp 64.8 -> 120.6, 1.86x; trace climbs to ~230). Disabling ppGpp *regulation* removes the feedback the allocation reads but not ppGpp *synthesis*. Growth slows the most (doubling +10.5 min, only 2 gens).
dnaA-2x advances replication re-initiation TIMING and degrades the central-carbon flux match (Toya r 0.727 -> 0.457) but does NOT raise the discrete max oriC ceiling (both peak at 4).

media-succinate's central-carbon FBA flux decorrelates from the glucose-grown Toya-2010 measurements (Toya r collapses to -0.058), with the largest flux shifts on the TCA / succinate-entry reactions — a clean carbon-source signature.
remaining_uncertainties: elong-down is a near-null at the 0.7x magnitude (doubling 49.3 vs 51.1 min) — the steady-state charging + variable-elongation machinery appears to compensate. Whether a larger cut (e.g. 0.4-0.5x) or a different translation knob produces a graded slowdown is open.

The proteome is the least discriminating axis: all variants stay at Schmidt r 0.70-0.74 / Wisniewski ~0.61. Whether a coarser-grained or pathway-resolved proteome readout would separate the variants is open.
tRNA charged fraction is pinned at ~0.97 across every variant including ppgpp-off and elong-down — the charging model may be insensitive to these levers, or the readout saturates.

followup_study_proposals.title: Deepen the strongest contrast — media / growth-condition response (dose of carbon sources)
followup_study_proposals.proposed_experiment:
Run a small panel of growth conditions (e.g. glucose, succinate, acetate,
glycerol, +amino-acids), each with its own full ParCa cache, and chart the
growth rate / central-carbon flux (Toya-r) / mass-composition response as a
function of carbon source. Builds directly on media-succinate, the
strongest showcase-4 contrast.

followup_study_proposals.title: Chase the ppGpp-off surprise — why does the pool rise, not collapse?
followup_study_proposals.proposed_experiment:
Decompose the ppGpp-off result: separate ppGpp *synthesis* (RelA/SpoT)
from the *regulatory* coupling, and test whether toggling synthesis vs
regulation independently reproduces the rise. Adds a synthesis-off /
regulation-off 2x2 to confirm the de-repression mechanism.

runs.name: showcase4-variant-sweep
runs.description:
5-variant x 2-seed multigen sweep on the mac mini, resumed from the
showcase-1 full ParCa caches. Variant 0 baseline / 1 ppgpp-off / 2 dnaA-2x /
3 elong-down on out/cache-showcase (glucose, 51-condition full ParCa);
variant 4 media-succinate on out/cache-succinate (condition=succinate /
fixed_media=minimal_succinate). Generations vary by phenotype: baseline /
dnaA-2x / elong-down / media reach 3 generations, ppgpp-off only 2.
max_steps 6500/cell; total sweep wall ~2982 s. Hive-partitioned parquet
history (experiment_id=showcase4_variants / variant / lineage_seed /
generation / agent_id). The 8 cross-variant comparison analyses
(v2ecoli/workflow/analyses/) consumed the parquet directly; sim_data
hydrated from out/sim_data-showcase/parca_state.pkl.gz; Schmidt/Wisniewski +
Toya-2010 validation attached. 8 figures rendered to PNG+SVG via
scripts/render_variant_comparison.py with variant_metadata
{0:baseline, 1:ppgpp-off, 2:dnaA-2x, 3:elong-down, 4:media-succinate}.

ppgpp-off-perturbs-ppgpp-and-growth.detail: ppGpp-off mean ppGpp 120.6 vs baseline 64.8 = 1.86x (in [1.5, 3.0]); doubling time 61.6 vs 51.1 min (+10.5, slowest of all variants; only 2 generations reached). NOTE: the pool RISES (de-repression), it does not collapse — the trace climbs to ~230 by end-of-run.

dnaa-2x-shifts-replication-and-flux.detail: Toya r drop 0.727 - 0.457 = 0.270 (in [0.15, 0.50]); re-initiation timing advances (oriC reaches 4 earlier, earlier 2nd-cycle re-init). BUT max oriC does NOT increase (both peak at 4), so the naive 'raises oriC count' expectation fails — the contrast is in timing + flux, hence PARTIAL.

elong-down-lengthens-doubling-time.detail: Doubling-time delta 49.3 - 51.1 = -1.8 min (expected +3..+30; measured marginally NEGATIVE). The 22->15.4 aa/s cut is a near-null on growth; mass / proteome / replication stay ~baseline. Steady-state charging + variable elongation appear to compensate at 0.7x.

media-shifts-central-carbon-flux.detail: Toya r drop 0.727 - (-0.058) = 0.785 (in [0.40, 1.50]) — the central-carbon flux decorrelates from glucose-grown Toya-2010; largest shifts on TCA / succinate-entry reactions. Cross-checks: dry mass halved (271 vs 492 fg), never multiforks (max oriC 2 vs 4), protein fraction up to 0.532. Strongest contrast of the sweep.

config.title: Variant scorecard — 7 metrics x 5 variants, colored by normalized delta vs baseline
config.caption: The headline summary: each cell is a measured metric (doubling time, dry mass, protein fraction, max oriC, mean ppGpp, Schmidt r, Toya r) for each variant, colored by its normalized delta vs baseline. media-succinate is the strongest multi-axis contrast (dry mass 271, max oriC 2, Toya r -0.058, protein 0.532); ppgpp-off is strongest on regulation/growth (ppGpp 121, doubling 61.6); dnaA-2x is partial (Toya r 0.457); elong-down is near-baseline.

visualizations.name: growth overlay (cell mass + instantaneous growth rate)

config.title: Cell mass + instantaneous growth rate, all 5 variants overlaid
config.caption: media-succinate (green) has the lowest cell-mass trajectory (~270 vs ~490 fg) and lowest growth rate; ppgpp-off's instantaneous growth rate decays over the run. Other variants track baseline.

config.title: Cap-immune doubling time per variant (ln2/mean mu)
config.caption: ppgpp-off is the slowest (mean 61.6 min, wide spread to 77 min); dnaA-2x fastest (48.4); elong-down ~baseline (50.2, the weak contrast); media-succinate slightly slow (56.6).

config.title: Mean dry-mass fractions per variant (protein / rRNA / tRNA / DNA / small-mol)
config.caption: media-succinate shifts composition most — protein up to 0.532 and small-mol down to 0.325; the other variants cluster near baseline.

config.title: Number of oriC over the cell cycle, all 5 variants overlaid
config.caption: baseline / ppgpp-off / dnaA-2x / elong-down all multifork to 4 oriC; dnaA-2x and elong-down reach 4 slightly EARLIER (advanced re-initiation). media-succinate never multiforks (stays 1->2), reflecting slow growth / no overlapping rounds — the clearest replication contrast.

config.title: ppGpp pool + tRNA charged fraction over the cell cycle, all 5 variants
config.caption: ppgpp-off (orange) ppGpp RISES to ~230 by end-of-run (highest of all, de-repression — NOT a collapse); other variants stay ~50-85. tRNA charged fraction is pinned at ~0.97 across every variant.

visualizations.name: central-carbon FBA flux delta + Toya correlation

config.title: Central-carbon flux delta vs baseline (per reaction) + Toya-2010 r per variant
config.caption: media-succinate produces the largest central-carbon flux shifts (TCA / succinate-entry reactions) and its Toya-2010 correlation collapses to -0.058 (baseline 0.727); dnaA-2x drops Toya r to 0.457; ppgpp-off slightly raises it to 0.764.

visualizations.name: proteome delta vs baseline + validation r

config.title: Per-variant proteome vs baseline (log-log) + Schmidt / Wisniewski r per variant
config.caption: The least-discriminating axis: every variant hugs the baseline proteome diagonal and the validation correlation stays flat (Schmidt r 0.70-0.74, Wisniewski ~0.61). ppgpp-off shows the most scatter (Schmidt 0.696). Uses the corrected SET monomer_counts (#185).
